local_metric_aggregates.name: algorithm_success
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: One when the native result classifies the optimization outcome as successful.

local_metric_aggregates.name: carving_iteration_count
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: Count of recorded carving iterations under the modern controller semantics.

local_metric_aggregates.name: committed_event_count
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: Count of committed R10 geometry states, including the initial state.

local_metric_aggregates.name: deformation_energy
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: Final unscaled Laplacian shape energy reported by the R10 diagnostics.

local_metric_aggregates.name: deformation_iteration_count
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: Count of recorded deformation line-search iterations.

local_metric_aggregates.name: final_cavity_volume_fraction
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: Final inward cavity volume divided by final outer-envelope volume; reported only for an empty or strictly valid inner boundary.

local_metric_aggregates.name: manufacturing_ready
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: One when the sealed manufacturing audit reports ready.

local_metric_aggregates.name: material_mass_change_fraction
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: Initial material mass minus final material mass, divided by initial material mass; deformation can make this value negative.

local_metric_aggregates.name: maximum_handle_scale_deviation
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: Maximum absolute deviation of a user-handle uniform scale from one.

local_metric_aggregates.name: normalized_maximum_displacement
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: Maximum source-vertex displacement divided by the maximum source bounding-box extent.

local_metric_aggregates.name: normalized_rms_displacement
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: RMS source-vertex displacement divided by the maximum source bounding-box extent.

local_metric_aggregates.name: projected_target_energy
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: Final projected balance-target energy reported by the R10 diagnostics.

local_metric_aggregates.name: targets_reached
local_metric_aggregates.semantics: One when all declared final balance targets are reached.
